# What should you charge to install this standby generator?

> Free standby generator install price calculator: enter the equipment, gas and electrical runs, permit, crew hours and callback risk, and get a price, the cash you need before install day and what an overrun costs. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
